primary: Use case: logo-brand. Design ONE polished original desktop app icon for 'Cindy OMP', derived from the attached two brand references. Reference 1 supplies only silver asymmetrical bob/fringe with a coral streak and cyan accents; reference 2 supplies the black cat with cyan eyes. Reduce them to ONE memorable minimalist graphic symbol: a front-facing graphite cat head silhouette with two proud triangular ears, one broad swept SILVER fringe crossing the upper forehead like the girl's hair, two large clean CYAN eye shapes, and ONE tiny coral accent in the silver fringe. No human face, no tiny illustration detail, no full body. A calm smart expression. Large connected bold shapes, geometric curves, strong silhouette, friendly professional developer tool. Keep eye shapes simple enough to be distinguishable at 16px; no fur, no whiskers, no highlights inside eyes, no teeth, no lettering, no extra symbols. Place the symbol centrally on a dark graphite rounded-square app tile with generous corner radius, flat matte surface, a very subtle lighter edge for use on both dark and light backgrounds. Symbol occupies about 75% of tile width; tile occupies 90% of a 1024x1024 square canvas, equal transparent outer margin on every side. The silver fringe and cyan eyes must separate clearly from charcoal cat/tile. Flat vector-like graphic, precision geometry, at most graphite, ivory/silver, cyan, coral. No gradients, no glow, no 3D bevel, no drop shadow outside tile, no watermark, no wordmark, no mockup or presentation board. True transparent alpha outside the rounded square. This is the final program logo asset, not an avatar illustration.
smallSizeVariant: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create the SMALL-SIZE OPTICAL VARIANT of the attached Cindy OMP logo, for 16 to 24 pixel Windows titlebar and tray use. Keep the same square composition, graphite rounded tile, silver cat ears and asymmetrical silver fringe, cyan eyes, one coral hair accent. Simplify aggressively while preserving recognition: silver hair becomes only ONE broad sweeping cap and ONE side lock; no fine hair strands, no gray shading lines, no glow, no cyan hair tips. Two large flat cyan almond eyes with NO pupils or internal highlights. Remove the nose and mouth completely. Cat ear outlines must be thick and bold. Use flat filled colors and strong geometry. Front-facing, centered, calm and friendly. Four colors maximum: dark graphite tile/face, silver-white hair/ears, cyan eyes, tiny coral slash. No extra outlines or details. Tile fits within a square canvas with equal 5% genuinely transparent outer margin, no crop, same rounded corner shape as the original. No text, no mockup, no presentation board, no shadow outside tile. Deliver ONE transparent PNG icon. This is not a new character; preserve the exact original icon's broad silhouette but make it unmistakable at 16px.
exports: tools/build-app-icons.cjs only resizes and packages the original generated artwork into PNG/ICO. No recoloring or redrawing.
